integrity: Exact rational checker supports finite cases; universal proof relies on cited Haar integration and elementary majorization. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the real sixth-to-second moment ratio of first-order matrix coefficients on Haar U(n), n>=2; not higher moments or other groups. The sixth-moment integration rule is prior mathematics; the strict spectral optimization and stability identity are the claimed contribution. Priority requires external checking beyond indexed sources.
title: Sharp sixth-moment majorization for real Haar-unitary matrix coefficients
